scope: Small deterministic input/shot-count/phase-continuity checks of the actual SequenceFire controller.
checks: No shot is emitted by idle walking loops.
One accepted click yields exactly one shot over three loops; walking frame order never resets.
Held trigger produces repeated shots; release emits no subsequent shot.
Cancel drops a pending shot as well as the held trigger.
Stationary single shot starts immediately, shows recoil/recovery and returns to the clean baseline.
Stationary automatic fire alternates the existing firing poses; last recoil completes after release.
